# Hand-picked MeshCore hashtag-channel name guesses, distinct from the
# vendored french.txt dictionary (see README.md) -- generic/thematic
# channel names a French MeshCore community deployment might use,
# gathered while debugging real captured GRP_TXT frames in this
# project. Always loaded in addition to whatever wordlist is active
# (see MC_DEFAULT_HASHTAG_EXTRAS in CMakeLists.txt).
#
# French department (fr-01..fr-99, fr-2a/fr-2b) and region (fr-ara,
# fr-paca, fr-occ, ...) abbreviations are NOT hand-picked here anymore --
# they're generated by meshcore_builtin_hashtag_candidates() (meshcore.c)
# and always tried by both this project's live dictionary attack
# (meshcore_hashtag_dict.c) and the offline meshcore-recover.c tool, so
# listing them here would just be redundant (an earlier version of this
# file had a typo'd "fr-pac" instead of "fr-paca" that never matched
# anything as a result -- the generator doesn't have that problem).
#
# Case variants (lower/UPPER/Title) are tried automatically for every
# entry here too -- see meshcore_name_case_variants().
bot
meteo
info
emergency
frblabla
gard
hamradio
technic
